description.content:
End-to-end smoke for a new SwiftShip integrator. Eight flows:
  1. Order creation (GraphQL)
  2. Rate-shop ranking (REST)
  3. Tracking lookup (GraphQL)
  4. Label generation (GraphQL)
  5. KYC submission (GraphQL)
  6. Wallet top-up (GraphQL)
  7. RMA creation (GraphQL)
  8. Channel sync status (GraphQL)

Every request ships with example values; no placeholders. Set the `SWIFTSHIP_API_KEY` and `baseUrl` env vars in `SwiftShip.postman_environment.json` and click **Run collection**.
API base URL. Use https://sandbox.swiftship.ai for the sandbox, https://api.swiftship.ai for production, or http://localhost:3000 for local dev.
Server-to-server API key from the admin portal (Settings → API keys). Use a sk_test_ key against the sandbox and sk_live_ against production.
Your tenant id. Visible in the admin portal URL (/t/<tenantId>/...). Not secret, but useful to log for support.
